component: Clear nonempty toolbar search before Escape reaches the close handler

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: SearchBar handles Escape on keydown. When its input is nonempty, it resets the value, prevents the default and stops propagation; the customization ancestor closes on keydown only if the event reaches it. The palette test waits for autocomplete and checks children become visible after Escape. This is the selected nested-component event order, not a rule to use keydown for every keyboard action. The old released wording does not match the current caller. No keyboard or accessibility test ran.
title: Clear nonempty toolbar search before Escape reaches the close handler
